skeleton_status: provider-free skeleton contracts are checked in under examples/ai/finrobot_translation/live_packages; live external package implementations are not checked in

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide built-in finance vendors, valuation formulas, report renderers, or web product services; live behavior must ship as external packages behind capability gates.

test_gates: manifest declares every live provider capability, credential env var, rate-limit policy, terms metadata, and replay fixture key
contract tests run with live_network=false and assert clean skips when optional provider credentials are absent
fixture replay tests validate response schema compatibility without importing yfinance, Finnhub, FMP, SEC, earnings, or Reddit clients
approval policy tests deny external network calls unless the matching provider capability is granted
schema tests preserve provider, replay_key, captured_at, source_schema, stale_after_days, and missing_field provenance
golden fixture tests reject unknown financial fields and stale market rows without calling live providers
package contract tests require deterministic output ordering across interpreter and bytecode replay runs
normalizer package remains installable without vendor adapter extras
offline fixture tests pin DCF, EV/EBITDA, P/E, target-price synthesis, and sensitivity outputs to tolerances
contract tests require explicit assumptions, currency, period, source provenance, and stale-data warnings
package tests reject hidden live data fetches and require all input tables to arrive through declared capabilities
numerical gates define acceptable tolerance drift before any live package replaces replay math
artifact contract tests validate HTML, PDF, chart spec, source annotation, AI disclosure, and output manifest schemas
snapshot tests compare deterministic renderer fixtures without browser network access
package tests require warnings for stale data, missing source provenance, and unsupported export formats
renderer extras stay optional so replay report contracts pass without wkhtmltopdf, playwright, plotly, or cloud storage
route parity tests cover replay UI paths and fail when live-only routes bypass fixtures
auth/session and background task logs are fixture-backed unless explicit product credentials are configured
download contract tests validate artifact manifests rather than fetching remote objects
accessibility and UI snapshot smoke tests remain provider-free and deterministic in CI
optional integration manifests declare clean skip behavior, fixture keys, schemas, and capability gates
contract tests run with live_network=false and assert absent optional dependencies do not fail provider-free CI
fixture tests validate FinGPT, FinRL, FinML, Backtrader, mplfinance, OpenBB, and Ollama metadata without imports
approval policy tests deny live optional integrations unless the matching capability and dependency gate are enabled

global_test_gates: no test in this plan may perform real network I/O
live package manifests must default live_network to false
optional provider credentials must be redacted and absent-safe
each package must declare capabilities before it can replace a replay fixture
the replay slice remains the golden contract until the corresponding package contract passes
